snippet.title: Super Sudoku (Homebrew SNES game)
snippet.description:
This is a homebrew Sudoku game for SNES, programmed for fun as part of the March 2019 RetroChallenge. One of the very few games supporting the NTT Data Keypad, besides the original JRA PAT online horse race betting system.


Project log / making of:


https://www.raphnet.net/divers/retro_challenge_2019_03/index_en.php
(free ROM download at the bottom of the page)





Cartridge sold by raphnet-tech:

https://www.raphnet-tech.com/products/super_sudoku/index.php
